{{Quote|I caught six the first day and thought I was the god of the forest. Then I named them all. My parents hadn't told me that whellays were destined for the dinner table. There'd been so much to do, I guess it hadn't occurred to them.|An anonymous Republic soldier|<ref name="AuthorsCut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
'''Whellays''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creatures native to the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Okator VIII]], located beyond the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Whellays were gentle animals that could easily be domesticated, and consequently were farmed for their meat and coats. Each whellay had a unique scented coat of [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and a unique way of whickering. [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|An anonymous soldier]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] once made a record for the [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] [[Historian/Legends|historians]] of the [[Palace of Memnii]], in which he remembered having caught and befriended more than six whellays during his [[Youngling/Legends|childhood]] on Okator VIII, during the [[Tionese War]]. The young man's pet whellays were killed when a group of [[Tionjack|Tionese warships]] destroyed the settlements of Okator VIII and [[Fire/Legends|burned]] the forests.

==Behind the scenes==
Whellays first appeared a cut story from ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' ([[2012]]) by [[Jason Fry]] that detailed an anonymous Republic soldier's experience on Okator VIII. Information on these creatures was released in an online supplement on the [[Star Wars Blog]] on [[January 8]], [[2014]].
